webster.text: To disprove; to prove to be false, defective or invalid; to overthrow; as, to confute arguments, reasoning, theory, error.

example.quote: The remarks of the commentator are acute; but they seem hardly to do justice to the meaning, much less to confute the reasoning of the author.
example.cite: John Adams, A Defence of the Constitutions of Government of the United States of America, vol. 1 (London, 1787), ch. 1
